name: Debbie Meyer GreenBags
description: Debbie Meyer GreenBags, 32-Pack (16M, 8L, 8XL), Reusable Food Storage Bags
features: Helps Preserve Produce Freshness: FoodFresh System Technology uses a proprietary natural mineral formulation designed to help manage ethylene gas, one of the natural factors that speeds produce aging. These reusable produce bags help preserve the freshness of fruits and vegetables while helping reduce food waste.

Use Again And Again: Each bag can be rinsed, dried, and reused 8-10 times, making these reusable produce bags a practical alternative to single-use storage bags. Ideal for shoppers, meal planners, and busy households storing fresh ingredients.

Everyday Produce Storage: Use these reusable food storage bags in the refrigerator, pantry, or on the countertop to organize fresh groceries after shopping. Suitable for everyday produce storage while helping keep fruits, vegetables, herbs, and cut flowers organized.

32-Pack With 3 Bag Sizes: Includes 16 Medium, 8 Large, and 8 Extra-Large reusable fruit storage bags. The gusseted design expands for leafy greens, berries, apples, lettuce, broccoli, herbs, and larger fruits or vegetables.

Made For Daily Use: Proudly made in the USA from BPA-free materials with FDA GRAS components. These reusable vegetable storage bags support everyday produce storage for households that shop fresh often.
